column1: # Town countries: a town takes GeoNames' country (its country code as the bundle's country, countries.tsv iso2), unless
# a row here keeps the country of the outline the town lies in (final architecture 2.1; owner decisions Q1/Q2). A row
# applies to the towns GeoNames files under `cc` whose outline country (the land function at the town: an assignment
# area, the country and province outlines, else the nearest outline within 22 km) is `country`, inside `within` (a
# zone or assignment key) when set. verify.mjs check 13 lists every town whose country differs from GeoNames' and fails
# on one no row (or a places-overrides.tsv adm0) explains. A town whose outline country differs from its own keeps the
# outline's as adm0_alt, so rule E still names it on that land (a border town inside a neighbour's simplified outline).
